title: Record Florida python length vs. average giraffe height

source.name: Record-breaking Burmese python capture, Big Cypress National Preserve

notes: On July 10, 2023, hunters captured a 19-foot female Burmese python (125 lb) in Big Cypress National Preserve, the longest python ever documented in south Florida -- about as long as an average adult giraffe is tall (roughly 18 feet).
